Order is not guaranteed. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [list[int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : List of selected edge IDs, empty if no edges selected. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} This cycle was created without explicit edge weights, so every edge's `weight` is `None` and the predicate never matches -- the selection comes back empty: ::: {#6ab2dda0 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_cycle_graph(4) .select_edges(lambda e: e.weight is not None and e.weight > 0.5) ) graph.get_selected_edge_ids() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` [] ``` ::: :::
